observations: Two car headlights are shown side by side on a tiled floor.
The headlights have a clear lens with a visible internal reflector and bulb housing.
The housing appears to be black plastic with some silver trim or molding.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' across the image.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlights themselves.
The headlights appear to be in used condition with some reflections and minor surface marks.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers to confirm originality. The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' suggests a listing, not proof of origin.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlights may not be original Toyota parts, or may be from a different brand or model.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the headlight housing showing any embossed brand or model markings, or a photo of the part number or VIN tag.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or non-original parts, which are typically lower in value.

risks.risk: The headlights may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken bulb housing).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens and bulb housing showing any cracks, scratches, or broken components.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The headlights may not fit the buyer's vehicle due to size or shape differences.
risks.proof: A photo showing the headlights installed on a vehicle or a comparison with the buyer's car's headlights.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially incompatible, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the headlight housing showing any brand or model markings.
Close-up of the lens and bulb housing to check for cracks or damage.
Photo of the part number or VIN tag if available.
Photo of the headlights installed on a vehicle or a comparison with the buyer's car.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
